newsitem.title: USA: AlliedSignal sees '97 sales and earnings up.
newsitem.headline: AlliedSignal sees '97 sales and earnings up.

text.p: AlliedSignal Inc Chairman and Chief Executive Lawrence Bossidy saaid Friday the company expects 1997 sales growth of around eight percent and earnings growth of 13 to 17 percent, excluding acquisitions.

Speaking at a Smith Barney Multi-Industry Conference, he said the company had an ambitious growth strategy. He said he saw the company carrying out acquisitions with $600 million to $1 billion in sales this year.
In response to a question, he said the company also plans further divestitures. He declined to give details.
For 1996, AlliedSignal had net sales of $13.97 billion and earnings per share of $3.61.
